questions.question: Dr. Taki must train young dentists on the importance of the Order. What is the first piece of advice he should give them?
options: Registration with the Order is an administrative constraint
Registration with the Order is the guarantee of a legal and ethical practice
Registration with the Order is optional
Registration with the Order is secondary
questions.explanation: Dr. Taki explains: 'Registration with the Order is the guarantee of a legal and ethical practice.' Dr. Touitou: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou must create a training center for professional regulatory law. What is the main objective?
options: Train dentists in their rights and duties
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'The main objective is to train dentists in their rights and duties.' Dr. Taki: 'I will participate in this training.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki must evaluate the performance of a young dentist in terms of ethics. Which measurement is the most important?
options: Compliance with ordinal and ethical rules
questions.explanation: Dr. Taki explains: 'Compliance with ordinal and ethical rules is the most important measure.' Dr. Touitou: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou must handle a crisis: a colleague who is struck off but continues to practice. What is the priority?
options: Report the illegal practice to the Order
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'The priority is to report the illegal practice to the Order to protect patients.' Dr. Taki: 'I will help you handle this situation.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki must train interns in ethical risk management. What is the fundamental principle?
options: Ethical risk management is a responsibility
questions.explanation: Dr. Taki explains: 'Ethical risk management is a fundamental professional responsibility.' Dr. Touitou: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou must create a guide to good ordinal practices. What is the main reference?
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Good practices should be based on Law 07-05 and the Order's texts.' Dr. Taki: 'I will contribute to this guide.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki must train young dentists in ordinal commitment. What is the key message?
options: Commitment is a service to the profession and patients
questions.explanation: Dr. Taki explains: 'Commitment is a service to the profession and patients.' Dr. Touitou: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou must create a research program in professional regulatory law. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Research aims to improve ordinal practices.' Dr. Taki: 'I will participate in the research.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki must create a reference practice in ethics. What is the pillar of excellence?
options: Knowledge and respect of ordinal law
questions.explanation: Dr. Taki explains: 'Excellence is based on knowledge and respect of ordinal law.' Dr. Touitou: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou must evaluate the impact of the Order on the profession. What is the role of the Order?
options: It is essential for the regulation of the profession
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'The Order is essential for the regulation of the profession.' Dr. Taki: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki must train interns in innovation in ordinal law. What current trend is important?
questions.explanation: Dr. Taki explains: 'Innovation concerns digitalization, dematerialization, and new forms of commitment.' Dr. Touitou: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou must create a competency evaluation system in ordinal matters. What is the objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Evaluation aims to improve ordinal practices.' Dr. Taki: 'I will participate in the evaluation.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki must handle an ethical conflict. What is the right attitude?
options: Act in accordance with the law and the Order's regulations
questions.explanation: Dr. Taki explains: 'The law and the Order's regulations are the guides for resolving ethical conflicts.' Dr. Touitou: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou must write an article on the future of the Order. Which trend should be emphasized?
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'The future lies in the Order serving patient protection.' Dr. Taki: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki must create an ethical quality label for practices. What are the main criteria?
options: Knowledge and respect of ordinal rules
questions.explanation: Dr. Taki explains: 'Knowledge and respect of ordinal rules are the fundamental criteria.' Dr. Touitou: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou must give a speech on the importance of the Order. What message should she convey?
options: The Order is a pillar of professional regulation
The Order is of no interest
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'The Order is a pillar of professional regulation.' Dr. Taki: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki must create a scholarship for students in ordinal law. What is the objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Taki explains: 'Encouraging excellence in ordinal law is an investment for the future.' Dr. Touitou: 'I will support this initiative.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou must pass on her knowledge of ordinal law. What is the most effective method?
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Personalized mentoring and case studies are the most effective methods.' Dr. Taki: 'I will get involved in mentoring.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki must create a peer network for young dentists in ordinal law. What is the objective?
options: Promote mutual aid and experience sharing
questions.explanation: Dr. Taki explains: 'Mutual aid and sharing are essential for young dentists.' Dr. Touitou: 'I will support this network.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou must write a conclusion to her work on the Order. What is the final sentence?
options: The Order is the guarantor of professional ethics
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'The Order is the guarantor of professional ethics.' Dr. Taki: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki must leave a legacy to the profession. What is the most beautiful legacy?
options: Skills in ordinal law and an example to follow
questions.explanation: Dr. Taki explains: 'Skills in ordinal law and example are the most beautiful legacy.' Dr. Touitou: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou must train future mentors in ordinal law. What is the first message to convey?
options: Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission
Mentoring is a source of income
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission.' Dr. Taki: 'I will convey this message.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki must write a letter to future dentists about the Order. What message should he convey?
options: The Order is a pillar of the profession
The Order is of no interest
questions.explanation: Dr. Taki explains: 'The Order is a pillar of the profession.' Dr. Touitou: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou must create an award for young dentists in ordinal law. What is the purpose?
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Stimulating excellence in ordinal law is essential for the evolution of the profession.' Dr. Taki: 'I will support this award.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki, after a career dedicated to the Order, receives a national tribute. Dr. Touitou is by his side. What is Dr. Taki's message to young dentists?
options: The Order is the heart of our profession
The Order is of no interest
questions.explanation: Dr. Taki concludes: 'The Order is the heart of our profession. It gives meaning to our practice.' Dr. Touitou: 'I am proud of you.'
